parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.
>Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
Note: You must specify at least one of PlaybookUuid and TaskFlow. You can call the DescribePlaybooks operation to obtain a valid PlaybookUuid.

parameters.name: TaskFlow
parameters.description: The XML configuration of the playbook.
